title: Welfare and Facilities Inspection Checklist
subtitle: Annual inspection of the Bloemfontein depot, 11 May 2026

rows: Bloemfontein depot, 9 Kameeldoring Street, Hamilton, Bloemfontein
Karabo Mokoena, Health and Safety Officer, with Elna Botha, health and safety representative

blocks.p: Each item is marked **Yes** (in order), **No** (a finding) or **N/A**. Numbers of toilets, basins and showers and the lighting and ventilation levels are checked against what the applicable regulations and your risk assessment set; where you are unsure, ask your registered Health and Safety practitioner.

rows: Separate, clean, lockable toilets for men and women, with paper, soap and hand drying
Enough toilets and basins for the number of employees on the largest shift
Sanitary bins in the women's toilets, emptied by the service provider
Clean drinking water close to work areas, with cups or a fountain
Separate changing rooms with lockers and seating
Showers working with hot and cold water
One of three showers in the men's room has no hot water
A clean eating area away from the loading bay, with tables, seating, a fridge and a way to heat food
No food or drink in the chemical store or the workshop
Lighting in the warehouse aisles, loading bay and yard is good enough for the tasks
Emergency lighting works on the escape routes
Workshop and battery charging bay ventilated, extraction fan working
Offices and eating area have openable windows or working air conditioning
General waste in closed bins, removed by the municipal service
Used oil, oily rags and fluorescent tubes kept apart and removed by a licensed contractor with a manifest
Last waste manifest not on file
Sanitary bin service record for April missing
Obtain the record from the service provider and file it
No hot water in one shower
Replace the lamps and add aisle lighting to the weekly check
Last waste manifest not on file
Obtain the manifest from the waste contractor and file it

blocks.p: The inspector checks each action on its due date and signs it off in the corrective action log. The next full inspection is due in May 2027, or earlier if the depot changes its layout or its number of employees.
